title: Guides & Playbooks
summary: The market knowledge your talent decisions depend on — centralized. Verata unifies company intelligence, executive data, and search management in one platform built for PE talent and executive search.
body_markdown:
Research


25 min


### Do CEO Traits Predict PE Exit Success? What 47,643 Appointments Reveal


A comprehensive analysis of whether CEO background characteristics predict positive exit outcomes for PE-backed companies.


Topics covered:


- 47,643 CEO appointments analyzed
- FDR-corrected hypothesis testing
- Machine learning achieves AUC of only 0.562


[Read guide](https://www.veratainsight.com/resources/guides/ceo-traits-pe-exits)


Research


15 min


### Does an MBA Make a Better PE CEO? The Data Says No


Analysis of 4,274 MBA-holding CEOs vs. 7,900 non-MBA CEOs across PE-backed companies.


Topics covered:


- MBA exit rate: 36.3% vs non-MBA 33.7%
- Top-10 MBA programs perform worse than average MBA
- Not significant after FDR correction


[Read guide](https://www.veratainsight.com/resources/guides/mba-pe-ceo-performance)


Research


18 min


### FAANG, MBB, and Elite Banking: Do Prestigious Employers Predict PE CEO Success?


We analyzed PE-backed CEO outcomes for executives with FAANG, MBB, and elite banking backgrounds.


Topics covered:


- FAANG CEOs have below-average exit rates
- Elite banking shows zero predictive signal
- MBB effect vanishes under rigorous testing


[Read guide](https://www.veratainsight.com/resources/guides/elite-pedigree-pe-exits)


Research


15 min


### What Actually Predicts PE CEO Success? Only 2 of 22 Traits Survived


After testing 22 CEO background traits with FDR correction and temporal validation, only 2 survived.


Topics covered:


- General management background and years of experience
- Effect sizes are still tiny (general management = seniority proxy)
- Full robustness gauntlet: FDR, era, temporal, causal


[Read guide](https://www.veratainsight.com/resources/guides/what-predicts-pe-ceo-success)
